ravi: Opening RC cut for model-service v2.3.1-rc2. Targeting narrow batch to minimize blast radius. Change window 2026-03-21 15:30-16:30 PST. Need QA, security, oncall ack + pin.

deploy-bot: build complete: rsvc-2.3.1-rc2-20260321 (sha: fed9a1). CI: unit ✅ integ ✅ smoke running. suggested pins: candidate=pin_802 fallback=pin_301.

anya: Kicking off 3-node canary (2% traffic) with kv warm pre-run: `./deploy/canary.sh --ver rsvc-2.3.1-rc2 --canary 2`

anya: Canary smoke quick pass: no 5xxs, p95 ~170ms. small spike in memory on node-1 but within threshold.

ode

own: Oncall here. We'll pre-warm KV cache on 8 nodes using `scripts/kv_warm.sh --nodes 8`. Ramp plan: 2% x20m -> 25% x20m -> 100% x20m. Abort if 5xxs >1% sustained for 5m or p95 >300ms.

jen: Security quick scan: no new external permissions. Note: telemetry tagging adds new metric keys, update dashboards post-promo. security-bot: scan result: no findings.

ravi: Draft release notes: attention-kernel perf tweak, kv warm optimization, telemetry keys. jen, can you +1?

jen: +1 from security. rotate ephemeral creds after promo as FYI.

anya: QA will run regression suite after 2% canary. hold if golden eval mismatches >2.5% or autoregressions appear.

ravi: Setting candidate pin now. @deploy-bot please set candidate pin_802 and ensure fallback pin_301 is staged.

deploy-bot: pins applied 123 candidate: pin_802 fallback: pin_301. Promo ticket: https://redwood.atl/rollouts/RC-20260321-002

own: Quick rollback snippet for runbook: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/model-service --to-revision=REV && curl -s -X POST https://ops-api/revert -d '{"pin":"pin_301"}'`

ravi: Go/no-go in T-8. Any holds?

jen: security no holds.

anya: QA waiting for the 20m canary.

ravi: Launching promo now. Will watch metrics and post status. :rocket:
